```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(tidypopgen)
```

# Load merged gt

```{r}
malagasy_merged <- gt_load(resrepo::path_resrepo("data/intermediate/rbind_data/malagasy_merge_master.gt"))
```

# Check chromosome order

```{r}
unique(show_loci(malagasy_merged)$chromosome)
rle(show_loci(malagasy_merged)$chr_int)$values
rle(show_loci(malagasy_merged)$chromosome)$values
```

# Check loci order 

```{r}
is_loci_table_ordered(malagasy_merged)
```

# Impute

```{r}
malagasy_merged <- gt_impute_simple(malagasy_merged)
```

#LD clumping

Linked loci are removed through LD clumping, (r2 > 0.5, window size = 50Kb).

```{r}
to_keep_LD <- loci_ld_clump(malagasy_merged, thr_r2 = 0.5, size = 50, return_id = TRUE)
malagasy_merged <- malagasy_merged %>% select_loci(all_of(to_keep_LD))
count_loci(malagasy_merged)
```

```{r}
if (file.exists(resrepo::path_resrepo("data/intermediate/rbind_data/malagasy_merge_master_v2.gt"))) {
  file.remove(resrepo::path_resrepo("data/intermediate/rbind_data/malagasy_merge_master_v2.gt"))
  file.remove(resrepo::path_resrepo("data/intermediate/rbind_data/malagasy_merge_master_v2.bk"))
  file.remove(resrepo::path_resrepo("data/intermediate/rbind_data/malagasy_merge_master_v2.rds"))
}
```

# Reorder 

```{r}
malagasy_merged <- gt_order_loci(malagasy_merged, use_current_table = FALSE, quiet = TRUE)
rle(show_loci(malagasy_merged)$chromosome)$values
rle(show_loci(malagasy_merged)$chr_int)$values
# save
gt_save(malagasy_merged)
# reload
malagasy_merged <- gt_load("/home/EJC199/Dropbox/gitdata/malagasy_diversity/data/intermediate/rbind_data/malagasy_merge_master_v2.gt")
rle(show_loci(malagasy_merged)$chromosome)$values
rle(show_loci(malagasy_merged)$chr_int)$values
```

# Write cleaned version out to a plink file

This file can be used to compare for FIS to plink. 

```{r}
gt_as_plink(malagasy_merged, "/home/EJC199/Dropbox/gitdata/malagasy_diversity/data/intermediate/Malagasy_all_clean", type = "bed", overwrite = TRUE, chromosomes_as_int = TRUE)
```
